summary: A +2 shortsword that lowers the critical-hit threshold and improves melee attacks against obscured targets.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 2 Piercing, 5 ft melee. Martial, one-handed, Finesse, Light and dippable.
fields.Organ Rearranger: Reduce the roll needed to critically hit by 1. This stacks and also applies to ranged and spell attacks. On melee weapon damage dice of 1 or 2, reroll and use the higher result. All melee damage dice and both equipped melee weapons can benefit. Throws do not benefit from the reroll. A second copy or Twist of Fortune can add another reroll.
fields.Shadow Blade: Advantage on melee weapon attack rolls against lightly or heavily obscured targets, including with the other equipped melee weapon.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by A’jak’nir Jeera in Crèche Y’llek.
fields.Base value: 480 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Flourish: With proficiency, Bonus Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. A Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Off Balance for 2 turns.
fields.Piercing Strike: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee attack for weapon damage. A Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. In standard modes the target takes 2 extra Piercing damage when hit. In Honour Mode it instead takes 2 extra damage of the original type from any damage source. Healing removes Gaping Wounds.
